prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the mold from tray center to vacuum drying oven.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: tray
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold is correctly placed at tray center and contains colored liquid.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A lab bench scene. Left: a blue-and-grey instrument with a red digital display reading "15.32" and a keypad, sitting on a white block platform. On its top plate is a white rack holding an upright tube with a red/orange cap, plus a second empty clear tube slot; a grey cable runs up from behind.

Centre-right: a white table on metal legs carrying a black horizontal rod with clamps/knobs and a white boxed unit at right; black cables loop down to the floor and toward the display unit.

Foreground: a white tray containing a teal-green liquid pool, a square multi-well plate with green wells, an uncapped clear cylindrical container, black blocks, and a small white cylinder at left.
observations: The tray shows a teal-green liquid pool spilled/pooled in the tray along with a square multi-well plate with green wells, an uncapped container, and assorted blocks — no single mold sitting cleanly at the tray center holding the colored liquid. The liquid appears outside the mold rather than contained in it.
